model.title: A resolution recognizing the 100th anniversary of Northwest Mississippi Community College and celebrating a century of educational excellence, workforce development, student success, and service to the people of Mississippi and the United States.

summary.text: The resolution seeks to recognize Northwest Mississippi Community College's 100th anniversary and celebrate its contributions to education, job training, student achievement, and service to Mississippi and the nation.
